ValidationRule.description: When the user selects the Customer name field,then the list of customers should be restricted to only customers with the source system 'CAP'.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false, $Profile.Name = 'ANZ CCRM Standard User', NOT(ISBLANK( AccountId )), Account.Source_System_Name__c <> 'CAP-CIS', RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Commercial_Opportunity' )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Unsupported customer profile selected. Please choose a valid CAP customer profile to proceed.
